title: 120 men held a mountain pass until their last round of ammunition ran out.

sources.text: The Tribune - Saga of last man, last round at Rezang La

caption:
120 men held a mountain pass until their last round of ammunition ran out.

Under Major Shaitan Singh, roughly 120 men held the position against a much larger Chinese force for nearly 18 hours during the Sino-Indian War. Official Indian Army history records only 14 survivors.

Major Shaitan Singh was posthumously awarded the Param Vir Chakra, India's highest military decoration for gallantry. The battle is still studied and commemorated as an example of holding a position at any cost.

Rezang La wasn't a battle India won on paper - but the stand itself became part of what the country points to when it talks about what it's capable of defending.
